node.title: Re: What am I doing wrong here?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
The main thing is probably the URL "http://~zach3327/public_html/chapter12/c12case1b.html": ~zach3327 is probably not the hostname. Try removing the http:// and starting the URL with just /~zach3327/... instead (you could also get the script's location in different formats via [mod://CGI].pm's url function, and if you need further URL manipulation, see [mod://URI] - Update: [id://1212732|see my other post]). It also seems that you've embedded hard newlines in the string as "Location:\n\t ..." - I'd recommend not doing that, i.e. "print "Location: /~zach3327/...".

I also see a few other issues:

  • Note the casing: vs. param('Name')
  • You're not using [doc://warnings], which would help you catch other potential problems if they arise.
  • Your style of HTML is fairly old, and contain at least one typo that I see right off the bat (...). If you are going from a tutorial of some kind, I think it's a pretty old one. That'd also explain the use of [mod://CGI].pm, which isn't really modern anymore. See also [id://1182902], [id://1177808], and [mod://CGI::Alternatives].
  • By printing out $name as part of the URLHTML without escaping it, you are exposing yourself to a [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Search?search=Cross-site%20scripting|Cross-site scripting] (XSS) attack ([https://excess-xss.com/|tutorial]). You should at least use escapeHTML from [mod://CGI::HTML::Functions].
  • You are printing some things yourself that you could be using [mod://CGI].pm's functionality for: see its header and redirect functions.

Edit: Fixed thinko.
